independence: Not established by this script; external authorship and a preselected model are required.

configuration.spelling_scope: reviewed replacements in web data only

assumption: ideal exact beneficial selection; no intentional mistakes

metric_notes.next_word: One query before typing each non-sentence-initial word; exact inflection required.
metric_notes.sentence_start: One query before typing each sentence-initial word, reported separately.
metric_notes.completion: Queries after typing at least one letter, along the ideal selection path; not independent trials.
metric_notes.heldout: The original held-out set is now a regression set after repeated reviews; fresh independent validation remains pending.
